heading: Annual report
lead: The annual report required by section 1752a(d) of this title shall include a full report of the activities of the Facility.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section 309(b)(1) of Pub. L. 96–221 redesignated subch. III as title III of act June 26, 1934, ch. 750, cited as a credit to this section.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section effective Oct. 1, 1979, see section 1806 of Pub. L. 95–630, set out as a note under section 1795 of this title.
